1) we search over the primitives that constitute a Transformer TensorFlow program and identify an architecture named Primer that has a smaller cost than the original and other variants for autoregressive language modeling, and 2) Primer’s improvements are mostly attributed to two modifications: squaring the ReLU activations and a depthwise convolution after each Q, k, and V projection of the self-attention layers.
squaring ReLU and adding a depth-wise convolution layer after the Q, K, V projections in the self-attention block can reduce the training cost of the Transformer by up to 50%.
squaring ReLU and depthwise convolution can improve the efficiency of Transformers for language modeling, and the resulting architecture can be called Primer.
